en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined urban boulevard with tram tracks and pedestrians. On the right stands a large ornate multi‑storey building with turrets and decorative facades, while older low buildings line the left side of the street. The view looks down the avenue toward distant domed public buildings. At the top of the postcard is printed text reading "Belgrad. Terazia."
